findings.title: TaskStatus enum missing VERIFYING state defined in spec.md
findings.suggested_fix: Add VERIFYING = "verifying" to TaskStatus enum. Per spec.md: VERIFYING is a transient state during judgment execution. The current enum only has 4 values (CREATED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ABANDONED).

findings.title: close_task atomicity gap — partial write possible if complete_task fails after judge.md persisted
findings.suggested_fix: Document the non-atomicity in close_task docstring. judge.md is written by judge_task, then complete_task writes task.md. If complete_task raises ConflictError, judge.md is already persisted but status is not COMPLETED.

residual_risks: The missing VERIFYING state means the protocol cannot correctly model a task that is mid-verification.
close_task atomicity is incomplete — Tier 2 and 3 are stubs that always pass, so 'no bypass' rule only enforced at Tier 1.
testing_gaps: No tests for judge_task -> judge.md roundtrip
No tests for close_task success path
No tests for close_task failure path (Tier 1 fails -> RuntimeError)
No tests for update_session with multiple consecutive calls
